skills.name: Blessing of the Fairy
skills.description: Grants 1 skill level for every 10 levels your highest level character has. Blessing of the Fairy and Empress's Blessing do not stack, so only the strongest skill will be active.

skills.name: Empress's Blessing
skills.description:
For every 5 levels on your highest level Cygnus Knight or Mihile character, this skill will gain 1 Skill Point. Blessing of the Fairy and Empress's Blessing do not stack, so only the strongest skill will be active.
This skill can reach a max of Lv. 30, based on your Cygnus Knight or Mihile character's Noble Mind skill.

missing.skill: Chrono Break Boost / Ego Weapon Boost / Shadow Flash Boost / Twin Blades of Time Boost (None)
missing.why: MISSING — IDs not located. No Boost core named for any of this class's 5th-job skills exists among the 400004xxx names in Skill/40000.img (GMS 270); V-skill Boost cores live in Skill/50000.img, scanned by a separate worker. Passive cores with no frames, so no visuals missing.

notes: Zero has no 1st-4th job advancements; skills unlock by level. Books: 10000 is the shared Beginner book (pulled via the raw WZ API — the skillbook API fails it on every attempt with a WZProperty cast error, like jobs 6000/6001/6002); 10100 is the level 100+ Beginner book; 10110 is labelled Alpha/Beta, 10111 Alpha, 10112 Beta — the books mix Alpha and Beta skills, so labels follow bookName. 10112's Critical Bind, Immune Barrier and Divine Leer are Transcendent skills filed in the Beta book.
Moon Strike, Piercing Thrust, Shadow Strike and other shared skills exist under BOTH 10000xxxx and 10100xxxx IDs (same names, different IDs); both books' copies are included.
One node in job 10000 (100000280) has no name in String/Skill.img, no frames and no icon retrievable from the WZ API; kept as skill-100000280 with icon null.

Zero's 5th-job set is the 4 class-specific actives (Chrono Break, Twin Blades of Time, Shadow Flash, Ego Weapon); all-class common V skills plus Might of the Nova are out of scope as in every other completed class.
